verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The 'AI-powered suggestions' for dynamic content is an adjacent feature, not a delegable assistant. The live chat support agent is human customer support, and 'autopilot' refers to rule-based automation workflows. An in-product AI assistant is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
